---
title: "Call Dictionary"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
source("R/page_helpers.R")
calls <- read.csv("data/calls.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
if (!"context" %in% names(calls)) calls$context <- ""
```

```{r banner, results='asis'}
show_banner("call_dictionary", "Call Dictionary")
```

** IN PROGRESS ** This call dictionary is currently under construction and is a 
collaboration between the biologists whom study Western Screech-owls across British
Columbia, Canada.

More info to come.

```{r entries, results='asis'}
type_order <- c("Song", "Double Trill", "Barking", "Begging", "Food Delivery Call", "Whinny")
all_types <- unique(calls$call_type)
known <- intersect(type_order, all_types)
unlisted <- setdiff(all_types, c(type_order, "Abnormal Vocalisations"))
call_types <- c(known, unlisted, intersect("Abnormal Vocalisations", all_types))

for (ct in call_types) {
  rows <- calls[calls$call_type == ct, , drop = FALSE]

  cat('<div class="call-type">\n')
  cat('<h2>', htmltools::htmlEscape(ct), '</h2>\n', sep = "")

  descriptions <- rows$description[!is.na(rows$description) & nchar(trimws(rows$description)) > 0]
  if (length(descriptions) > 0) {
    cat('<p class="call-type-description">', htmltools::htmlEscape(descriptions[1]), '</p>\n', sep = "")
  }

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(rows))) {
    row <- rows[i, ]
    cat('<div class="call-example">\n')

    meta_parts <- c()
    if (!is.na(row$context) && nchar(trimws(row$context)) > 0) {
      meta_parts <- c(meta_parts, htmltools::htmlEscape(row$context))
    }
    if ("subspecies" %in% names(row) && !is.na(row$subspecies) && nchar(trimws(row$subspecies)) > 0) {
      meta_parts <- c(meta_parts, paste0("<em>", htmltools::htmlEscape(row$subspecies), "</em>"))
    }
    if (!is.na(row$location) && nchar(trimws(row$location)) > 0) {
      meta_parts <- c(meta_parts, htmltools::htmlEscape(row$location))
    }
    if (!is.na(row$date) && nchar(trimws(row$date)) > 0) {
      meta_parts <- c(meta_parts, htmltools::htmlEscape(row$date))
    }
    if (length(meta_parts) > 0) {
      cat('<p class="call-meta">', paste(meta_parts, collapse = " · "), '</p>\n', sep = "")
    }

    spectro_path <- file.path("www/spectrograms", row$spectrogram_file)
    if (file.exists(spectro_path)) {
      cat('<img class="spectrogram" src="', spectro_path, '" alt="Spectrogram of ',
          htmltools::htmlEscape(ct), '">\n', sep = "")
    }

    audio_path <- file.path("www/audio", row$audio_file)
    if (file.exists(audio_path)) {
      cat('<audio controls preload="none" src="', audio_path, '"></audio>\n', sep = "")
    }

    cat('</div>\n')
  }

  cat('</div>\n')
}
```
